docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Nariman’s survey of the Sanskrit Buddhist literature, the Mahāyāna sūtras, Aśvaghoṣa, the avadānas and the Tantras, put together from the studies of Winternitz, Lévi and Huber (Bombay, 1923). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Literary history of Sanskrit Buddhism; from Winternitz, Sylvain Levi, Huber · Nariman, Gushtaspshah Kaikhushro, d. 1933, Winternitz, Moriz, 1863-1937, Lévi, Sylvain, 1863-1935, Huber, Eduard, 1879-1914 · 1923, 432 scanned pages. Published 1923; G. K. Nariman died 1933, Moriz Winternitz 1937, Sylvain Lévi 1935 and Édouard Huber 1914; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
